exact_definitions: def spatialTrace (A : FourMatrix) : Real := A 1 1 + A 2 2 + A 3 3
def slopeRepresentative (A : FourMatrix) : FourMatrix := A - (spatialTrace A / 3) • observerMetric
exact_target_signatures: theorem observerMetric_sky_contraction_zero (n1 n2 n3 : Real) (hn : n1^2 + n2^2 + n3^2 = 1) : (∑ i : Fin 4, skyVector n1 n2 n3 i * (observerMetric.mulVec (skyVector n1 n2 n3)) i) = 0

theorem slopeRepresentative_sky_contraction (epsilon chi b2 b3 n1 n2 n3 : Real) (hn : n1^2 + n2^2 + n3^2 = 1) : (∑ i : Fin 4, skyVector n1 n2 n3 i * ((slopeRepresentative (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3)).mulVec (skyVector n1 n2 n3)) i) = Cas03C02.familyEvaluation epsilon b2 b3 chi n1 n2 n3
theorem slopeRepresentative_boostedB_symmetric (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) (i j : Fin 4) : slopeRepresentative (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3) i j = slopeRepresentative (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3) j i
